content.text: Register doesn't pass a provider, so the default applies.

candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is undefined, the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider (it only spreads dto, role and status). So email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. At login, AuthService.validateLogin sees user.provider !== 'email' and returns 422 `needLoginViaProvider:google`.
Register doesn't set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly. It relies on the default in UsersService.create, which is wrong.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
